To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the maximum value of the glass forming ability is obtained for the composition (GeSe 2)60(G eTe)20(P bTe)20, the minimal volume of the voids is obtained for the glass (GeSe 20)60(G eSe 2)10(PbSe)30 and the minimal energy for their formation is obtained for the (GeSe2)(60)(GeTe)(10)(PbSe)(30) glass
the glass forming ability, the volume of the microvoids and the energy for microvoids formation in glasses from the Ge-Se-Pb system depend on their composition.

the chalcogenide GeTe-based glasses have been studied by DTA, the temperatures of glass transition, crystallization and melt are obtained, the glass forming ability, micro-voids volume, energy for their formation are determined.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermomechanical characteristics (Tg, Tc, Tm, KG, Vh, and Eh) of the glasses from the GeS2-GeTe-Sb2Te3 system.
the thermomechanical properties of chalcogenides from the GeSe 2-GeTe -PbTe system.
the thermomechanical characteristics, glass forming ability, and micro-void formation in glasses from the GeS2-GeTePbTe system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the glass forming ability is the main factor which controls the thermomechanical characteristics.
the composition (GeSe 2) 60(GeTe ) 20(PbTe ) 20 is the most perspective for the production of glassy material with the highest thermal stability.
the chalcogenide glass from the GeSe 2-GeTe- PbTe system has good thermomechanical characteristics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chalcogenide glass with the highest glass forming ability is (GeSe2)(0.60)(GeTe)(0.20)(PbTe)(0.2)
the composition GeSe2:GeTe:TePb = 60:20:20 is the best glass forming composition in the GeSe2âGeTeâTePb system.
the glass forming ability of chalcogenidic glasses from the Ge-Se-Te-Pb system is higher than that of the glasses from the Ge-Sb-Te system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to obtain a chalcogenide glass with a high glass forming ability, a high thermal stability and a low microvoids volume in a wide composition range.
the chalcogenide glass from the GeSe-GeTe-PtTe system with composition (GeSe)60(GeT)20(PtT)20 possesses the maximum glass-forming ability.
the chalcogenide glass with the composition (GeSe 2) 60 (GeTe) 20 (PbTe) 20 is the most promising for the creation of optical waveguides.
